note: Arkansas EFA pre-approval portal at preapprove.schoolchoicear.org. This replaced the old ADE 'EFA Expense Preapproval Request' Google Form (Nov 2026). The portal is a custom web form that accepts file uploads directly and limits the learning-connection field to 200 words, so it does NOT support URL prefill the way the Google Form did. ClearClaim now prepares the answers for the family to paste in; it never submits.
